name: Aya Akiyama
source:
Aya is independent and reckless, driven in equal parts by her curiosity and a deep-seated longing for excitement. To her, any obstacle is regarded as a challenge, and it's practically a miracle to see her back down once she's intrigued.

As soon as she was old enough, Aya moved to the city to strike out on her own, though she quickly grew bored of her routine. She tried to fill the gaps with as many adventurous pastimes as she could, but it never took long for them to lose their appeal. In her search, she stumbles across the Human Reignition Project.

Unlike most of the project's members, Aya has a distinct dislike of the growing reliance on technology. Although the HRP might not have the like-minded individuals she was expecting, she hopes it will at least serve as a way to occupy her time - if only for a little while.
